Question: Can we distribute the meet of animal of Eid ul Azhaa to non Muslims persons? Answer ID: 15070 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1284/1284=M/1430) You can give the Qurbani meat to non-Muslims as well: ویھب منھا ۔۔۔ المسلم والذمي (الھندیۃ ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
